Yapay zekâ projelerinde proje lideri ve ekip kaptanı.", "url": "https://sevgane.com/tr/", "image": "https://sevgane.com/img/yunusevgane.png", "email": "yunus@webyapar.com", "telephone": "+90 531 679 10 14", "knowsAbout": ["AI project management", "Large language models (LLM)", "Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)", "AI agents", "LLM fine-tuning", "AI governance (ISO/IEC 42001)", "Team building and leadership", "Remote team management", "Project management", "Agile (Scrum)", "Information security (ISO/IEC 27001)", "Full-stack DevOps", "Yapay zekâ proje yönetimi", "Yapay zekâ yönetişimi"], "sameAs": ["https://linkedin.com/in/yunusevgane", "https://github.com/yunusevgane", "https://instagram.com/yunusevgane", "https://twitter.com/yunusevgane"], "knowsLanguage": ["tr", "en"]}]}</script><style id="sevgane-tasarim">/* sevgane.com — tasarım yenileme (8 Kas 2026): Gece Lacivert + tek amber vurgu, Fraunces/Inter.
   Jetonlar --mx-site-* (desing.colors); bu blok yalnız tipografi ritmi, boşluk, yüzey ve hareketi kurar. */
:root{--sv-line:rgba(233,237,245,.12);--sv-muted:#A9B4C8;--sv-r:14px;--sv-dur:250ms}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--mx-font-sans);background:var(--mx-site-bg);color:var(--mx-site-text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;line-height:1.65}
#content h1,#content h2,#content h3,#footer h2,#footer h3{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.018em}
::selection{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mx-site-primary);outline-offset:3px}
/* Hero: ortalı, geniş boşluk, serif display, amber hairline */
#content [class*="-hero2"]:not([class*="-hero2-"]){min-height:680px}
#content [class*="-hero2-container"]{max-width:1000px;padding:132px 24px 120px}
#content [class*="-hero2-badge"]{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(227,182,92,.5);color:var(--mx-site-primary);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;padding:9px 22px;backdrop-filter:none;margin-bottom:34px}
#content [class*="-hero2-title"]{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.35rem,5.2vw,4.25rem);line-height:1.07;letter-spacing:-.028em;max-width:920px;margin-bottom:26px}
#content [class*="-hero2-title"]::after{content:"";display:block;width:64px;height:2px;background:var(--mx-site-primary);margin:30px auto 0}
#content [class*="-hero2-desc"]{color:#B7C1D4;font-size:1.18rem;line-height:1.75;max-width:690px;margin-bottom:44px}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn"]{border-radius:8px;min-height:52px;letter-spacing:.01em;box-shadow:none;transition:transform var(--sv-dur) ease-out,background-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out,border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-primary"]{background:var(--mx-site-primary);color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-secondary"]{background:transparent;color:var(--mx-site-text);border:1px solid rgba(233,237,245,.3)}
#content [class*="-hero2-btn-secondary"]:hover{border-color:var(--mx-site-primary);background:rgba(227,182,92,.08)}
/* Bölüm başlıkları ve kartlar: bol boşluk, ince çizgi, ton ile yükselti (gölge yok) */
#content h2{line-height:1.18}
#content [class*="-values-title"]{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.7rem)}
#content [class*="-values"]:not([class*="-values-"]){padding-block:104px}
#content [class*="-values-card"]:not([class*="-values-card-"]){border:1px solid var(--sv-line);border-radius:var(--sv-r);box-shadow:none;transition:transform var(--sv-dur) ease-out,border-color var(--sv-dur) ease-out}
#content [class*="-values-card"]:not([class*="-values-card-"]):hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(227,182,92,.45)}
/* İç sayfa gövdesi: ortalı okunur sütun (≈72ch), güçlü h2, amber bağlantı */
#content section:not([class])>*{max-width:72ch;margin-inline:auto}
#content section:not([class]){padding:56px 24px 96px}
#content section:not([class])>h2{margin-block:2.4em .6em;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.8vw,2.2rem)}
#content section:not([class])>h3{margin-block:2em .5em;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--mx-site-text)}
#content section:not([class])>h4{margin-block:1.6em .4em;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--mx-site-primary);font-family:var(--mx-font-sans);font-weight:600}
#content section:not([class])>p,#content section:not([class])>ul,#content section:not([class])>ol{font-size:1.04rem;line-height:1.8;color:#C9D1E0}
#content section:not([class]) li{margin:.35em 0}
#content section:not([class]) a{color:var(--mx-site-primary);text-underline-offset:3px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
#content section:not([class]) a:hover{text-decoration-thickness:2px}
#content section:not([class]) img{border-radius:var(--sv-r);border:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
#content [class*="-stats-number"]{font-family:var(--mx-font-heading);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
/* Sayfa başlığı bandı */
#content [class*="-title"] h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.1rem);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:none}
#content [class*="-oz-chip"]:not([aria-pressed="true"]){background:var(--mx-site-surface-2);border-color:#7384A3}
#content [class*="-pd5-cta-wa"]{background:var(--mx-site-surface-2);border-color:var(--sv-line)}
/* WhatsApp: tek vurgu rengi */
a.whatsapp{background:var(--mx-site-primary)!important;color:var(--mx-site-primary-contrast)!important;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
a.whatsapp *{color:inherit!important;fill:currentColor}
/* Altbilgi */
#footer{border-top:1px solid var(--sv-line)}
/* Çerez bandı: motor cookie.css'indeki .cookie-banner (480px kart, translateX(-50%)) modül şeridini bozuyordu */
.cookie-banner[data-mx-cookie]{left:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:auto;max-width:none;transform:none;border-radius:0;padding:0;animation:none;font-family:var(--mx-font-sans)}
/* Hareket: yalnız tek sefer giriş; azaltılmış harekette kapalı */
@keyframes svUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){#content section:not([class])>*{animation:svUp .5s ease-out both}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{animation-duration:.001ms!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important}}
@media (max-width:768px){#content [class*="-hero2-container"]{padding:88px 20px 80px}#content [class*="-values"]:not([class*="-values-"]){padding-block:72px}}
</style>
